title: Shoei Premium Fleece-Lined Helmet Bag
features: Premium fleece-lined interior protects helmet from scratches and dust
Durable water-resistant exterior material for all-weather storage
Reinforced handles and shoulder strap for easy transport
description:
Built to protect your helmet investment between epic journeys, the Shoei Premium Fleece-Lined Helmet Bag from Shoei delivers comprehensive hygiene, drying, and surface protection. Built with Fleece-Padded Protective Enclosure Shielding Against Scratches and UV, it boasts an installation rating of 1.0 / 10 (Direct wipe application or plug-and-play operation).

The Shoei Premium Fleece-Lined Helmet Bag from Shoei is a must-have maintenance asset for riders who value helmet longevity. It keeps premium EPS liners hygienic, odor-free, and protected between track days and long-haul expeditions.
